about: Dao Insights: run-only buffs picked at Secret Realm shrines; they stack by phase and path.

records.name: Water Frost
records.text: Water heroines' S1 has a 30% chance to Frost Seal

records.name: Wood Thunder
records.text: Wood heroines' multi-hit techniques strike once more for 30% ATK

records.name: Fire Embers
records.text: Fire Poison from Fire heroines deals 50% more damage

records.name: Earth Jade
records.text: Earth heroines' healing and shields are 25% stronger

records.name: Sword Resolve
records.text: Sword heroines' S1 deals 30% more to enemies below half health

records.name: Guardian Wall
records.text: Guardians start each battle with a Spirit Shield of 100% ATK

records.name: Shadow Haste
records.text: Shadow heroines have Wind Step for the first 2 turns

records.name: Talisman Bind
records.text: Delays from Talisman heroines last 1 turn longer

records.name: Arcane Flux
records.text: Arcane area techniques deal 15% more damage

records.name: Healer Dew
records.text: Healers' heals also grant Lotus Dew for 1 turn

records.name: Harmony Flow
records.text: Harmony chains give 5% more per link

records.name: Kindred Echo
records.text: Kindred Qi gives 5% more per repeat

records.name: Qi Spring
records.text: +2 Spirit Qi at the start of each battle

records.name: Shield Breaker
records.text: Hits on a Qi shield break 1 more segment

records.name: Phoenix Blessing
records.text: The first heroine to fall each battle revives at 20% health

records.name: Mark Of Fate
records.text: Enemies start each battle with Karmic Mark for 1 turn
